entries.tutorialExcerpt: Leno lace on the rigid heddle is made by using a pick-up stick to cross pairs of warp threads, locking them in that twisted position for several picks before releasing. The twisted warp threads grip the weft and create an open, lacy structure within the plain-weave ground.

entries.tutorialTitle: Woven tote bag on a frame loom
entries.tutorialSubtitle: A 35 × 30 cm tote bag woven in thick cotton warp and weft on a frame loom, joined at the sides after finishing
entries.tutorialExcerpt: Two woven panels, each 35 × 30 cm, are worked on a frame loom in plain weave using medium-weight cotton rope, then joined at the sides and base with a ladder stitch. Cotton handles are braided and secured at the top of each panel.
